import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Compute effect sizes using Welch's t-test
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, col_idx]
        x0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, col_idx]
        if len(x1) > 0 and len(x0) > 0:
            t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x1, x0, equal_var=False)
            effect_sizes.append((abs(t_stat), fid))
        else:
            effect_sizes.append((0, fid))
    
    # Sort by effect size and select top features
    effect_sizes.sort(reverse=True)
    top_features = [fid for _, fid in effect_sizes[:5]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in top_features]].T)
    to_remove = set()
    
    for i in range(len(top_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_features)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i, j]) >= 0.6:
                # Remove the less significant one
                fid1, fid2 = top_features[i], top_features[j]
                # Find indices in effect_sizes
                idx1 = next((k for k, (_, f) in enumerate(effect_sizes) if f == fid1), -1)
                idx2 = next((k for k, (_, f) in enumerate(effect_sizes) if f == fid2), -1)
                if idx1 != -1 and idx2 != -1:
                    t1 = effect_sizes[idx1][0]
                    t2 = effect_sizes[idx2][0]
                    to_remove.add(fid1 if t1 < t2 else fid2)
    
    # Final columns selection
    columns = [fid for fid in top_features if fid not in to_remove]
    
    # Select top drivers
    drivers = [fid for _, fid in effect_sizes[:MAX_DRIVERS] if fid in columns]
    
    # Create interaction terms (only between top drivers)
    products = []
    if len(drivers) >= 2:
        products = [(drivers[0], drivers[1])]
    
    # Create loadings dictionary
    loadings = {}
    for fid in columns:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, col_idx]
        x0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, col_idx]
        if len(x1) > 0 and len(x0) > 0:
            t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x1, x0, equal_var=False)
            loadings[fid] = t_stat
    
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=tuple(columns), products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
